verdict: NEGATIVE — the CatBoost agent-tune loses @1 (-0.100) and @3 (-0.108) to the verified sweep, only edges @10. Even vs the XGBoost agent it merely ties @3 and loses @1. Cause: catastrophic eval->test decay (-0.370 @1), worse than _270's russell/50; the eval window did not generalize. The CatBoost sweep is the robust default; not promoted.

thread_closure.summary: Across all 5 pattern-match cells, agent-tuning CatBoost is opportunistic not dependable: sp500/50 WIN (+0.300@1), sp500/40 & russell/40-200d @1-loss-but-@3-win, russell/50 marginal mixed, russell/40/100d clear loss. Outcome set by eval->test decay direction (agent can't see it). Not horizon-specific (the H=100 extension behaves like H=200). No remaining pattern-match to try.
